# Mix And Sound Design Instructions

- Build a truthful mix hierarchy: dialogue or lead vocal, critical source audio,
  music, SFX, and ambience.
- Duck music/SFX under speech only when needed, and manually review automatic
  ducking for pumping, awkward fades, and masked words.
- Keep dialogue centered unless a documented format or spatial reason applies.
- Do not use music, drones, impacts, fake crowds, fake reactions, risers, or
  stingers to imply danger, guilt, scale, causality, emotion, or endorsement
  unsupported by the content.
- Preserve music dynamics for performances, covers, and music-led videos.
- Track every third-party/generated music, SFX, stem, loop, sample, ambience,
  voice model, or sound library item in `AUDIO-SOURCE-LOG.md` or `SOURCE-LOG.md`.
